The Velmoria Energy Regulatory Commission licenses electricity and gas providers, sets transmission tariffs, and oversees the Grid Authority's compliance with the 2045 net-zero commitment. It is independent of the Ministry of Energy by statute, though its commissioners are ministry-appointed.

**Why this matters**: fictional analog to a real energy regulator note.

syn-country-astrelle
SYNTHETIC — Astrelle, a fictional G7-style country, provinces and federal structure mapped
Astrelle is a fictional federal country with nine provinces and two autonomous territories. Its federal parliament sits in the capital, Norvann, and each province retains control over education and healthcare policy, mirroring a real-world federal/provincial split.

**Why this matters**: fictional analog to a real G7-style country-mapping note.

syn-velmoria-central-reserve
SYNTHETIC — the Velmoria Central Reserve, the fictional nation's central bank
The Velmoria Central Reserve sets the benchmark interest rate, supervises retail banks, and manages the provincial currency peg. Its governor is appointed for a seven-year term, deliberately longer than the Prime Minister's electoral cycle to insulate monetary policy from short-term politics.

**Why this matters**: fictional analog to a real central-bank note.

widgetData.source_sentence: who regulates the stock exchange in this fictional country
sentences:
syn-country-korvatia
SYNTHETIC — Korvatia, a fictional European-style country, regions and a contested overseas territory
Korvatia has 14 mainland regions and one contested overseas territory, Maren Island, currently in a decades-long independence-referendum process. Korvatia's regions each elect their own assembly, with the national government retaining control over defense and foreign affairs.

**Why this matters**: fictional analog to a real European-style country-mapping note, including a contested-territory subplot.

syn-velmoria-securities-commission
SYNTHETIC — Velmoria Securities Commission, the fictional regulator overseeing the national stock exchange
The Velmoria Securities Commission licenses brokers, enforces disclosure rules for listed companies, and oversees the Velmoria Exchange. It gained expanded enforcement powers after a 2016 market-manipulation scandal involving a mid-cap logistics firm.

**Why this matters**: fictional analog to a real securities regulator note.

syn-velmoria-national-trust
SYNTHETIC — the Velmoria National Trust, a fictional sovereign investment fund seeded by resource royalties
The Velmoria National Trust was seeded in 1985 from offshore gas royalties and now manages a diversified portfolio across infrastructure, equities, and provincial development projects. It is legally separate from the annual government budget, a deliberate design choice to prevent short-term raiding of long-term savings.

**Why this matters**: fictional analog to a real sovereign-wealth-style fund note.

widgetData.source_sentence: when is the annual report due and who audits it
sentences:
syn-annual-report-deadline
SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE — the fictional company's annual report deadline and which external auditor signs off
The annual report is due to the fictional regulator by March 31st each year; the external auditor (a fictional firm, Kestrel & Boyd) needs the draft financials four weeks earlier to complete sign-off in time.

**Why this matters**: a recurring compliance deadline with a real external dependency (the auditor's own lead time), the kind of fact that's costly to forget.

**Why this matters**: fictional analog to a real securities regulator note.

example-quarterly-board-deck-deadline
SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE — a recurring quarterly board-deck deadline and who owns which section
The quarterly board deck is due the first Monday of the new quarter. Finance owns the numbers section, product owns the roadmap slide, and the fictional CEO persona in this example always wants the risks slide reviewed by legal before it goes to the board, not after.

**Why this matters**: recurring institutional deadlines with named owners are exactly what should live in permanent memory rather than being re-explained every quarter.
